title: PowerShell / DSC
headline: PowerShell DSC describes and applies a desired configuration state.
rules: Version configuration and test changes before deployment.
failures: Missing DSC resources can block configuration.
Configuration drift may reappear without monitoring.

flashcards.question: What is configuration drift?
flashcards.answer: A difference between the intended and actual configuration.
